description: Java enum class 'Sensor' defining various sensor types and their properties for a automotive control software project, including categories, units, value ranges, and related methods.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: An enum representing various sensor types and their properties used in automotive control system firmware.

methods.name: getSensorsForCategory
methods.description: Returns a collection of sensors belonging to a specified category.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Finds a sensor by its name or returns a default value if not found.

methods.name: processAdvance
methods.description: Processes advance values to keep them within expected bounds.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the sensor.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the sensor.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units of measurement for the sensor.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum value the sensor can represent.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum value the sensor can represent.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the background color associated with the sensor.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the memory offset associated with the sensor.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the sensor value.

methods.name: translateValue
methods.description: Adjusts the sensor value based on sensor type, e.g., for timing sensors.
